title: ERP document model — shared definitions
description: The definitions every ERP document family composes from: identifiers, money, quantities, rates, dates, the closed docstatus vocabulary and the two line shapes (transaction and tax). This schema is not itself a document family — it declares no x-erp-document — so it has no workflow and no state enum; the families $ref into it so that a unit of measure, a currency code or a line item means exactly one thing across the whole model. A family that redefined 'amount' locally could drift from every other family while still validating, which is why these are shared definitions rather than per-family copies.

identifier.description: A document or master identifier (item code, warehouse, party, account, voucher). Shape-constrained so prose cannot drift into a key field; the value set is owned by the data, not by this schema.

label.description: Free-text human display name or description.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code. The closed three-letter shape is enforced; the value set is the ISO standard, deliberately not duplicated here.

money.description: A non-negative monetary amount in the document's own currency. Signs are carried by the side of the double entry, never by a negative amount.

rate.description: A non-negative unit rate or valuation.

docstatus.description: The closed upstream docstatus vocabulary the document model adopts: 0 draft, 1 submitted, 2 cancelled. Every lifecycle schema pins this enum and tests/test_assets.py proves it equals the docstatuses its workflow's states declare.

account.description: The tax or charge account the row posts to.

rate.description: The percentage applied, when the row is rate-derived rather than an explicit charge.

description.description: The line description, which the upstream shape allows to differ from the item's own name.

amount.description: The line total. Optional so a caller may send qty and rate and let the platform derive it.

warehouse.description: Link to the warehouse the line is fulfilled from, for families whose lines touch stock.

harvest: field shapes shared across doctypes (identifier, currency, amount, quantity, rate, date)
the docstatus closed vocabulary 0 draft / 1 submitted / 2 cancelled
the child-table row shape (item, qty, rate, amount, warehouse) for transaction doctypes
x-erp-provenance.note: Shared field shapes from the upstream doctype surface, re-expressed. No upstream file was read into this repository, and no upstream code, schema or text is copied or vendored — the upstream is GPL-3.0 and a pattern source only.
